# Related Backblaze B2 sample applications

The [`backblaze-b2-samples`](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples) organization and the [Backblaze Labs catalog](https://backblazelabs.com/) contain applications that complement these reference architectures. The projects below demonstrate offload, extraction, search, pre-labeling, dataset, training, and simulation patterns on B2. They show B2-side patterns; the integrations table in the README lists how each third-party tool connects.

## Closest workflow matches

<!-- catalog:samples-workflow:start -->
| Sample | What it demonstrates | Most relevant here |
|---|---|---|
| [Rosbag2 Cloud Offload](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/rosbag2-cloud-offload) | Uploads closed rosbag2 splits with presigned PUT URLs, deletes the local copy only after head_object confirms the upload, builds a Parquet session catalog, and emits a presigned-GET replay manifest. It is a robot-scale demo of the B2-side pattern, not a fleet logger. | [drive-log-offload-ingest](../architectures/drive-log-offload-ingest/architecture.md), [simulation-resim-evaluation](../architectures/simulation-resim-evaluation/architecture.md) |
| [Roboflow Inference Frame Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/roboflow-inference-frame-archive) | Runs edge inference and archives only flagged frames and their predictions to B2, with Parquet roll-ups. It is an analogue of trigger-based event upload from a vehicle. | [drive-log-offload-ingest](../architectures/drive-log-offload-ingest/architecture.md) |
| [CLIP Video Scene Search](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/clip-video-scene-search) | Segments video with PySceneDetect, embeds scenes with OpenCLIP, and stores a FAISS index on B2 for text or image scene search. | [sensor-lake-scenario-mining](../architectures/sensor-lake-scenario-mining/architecture.md) |
| [YOLO Drone and Dashcam Footage Detection](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/yolo-drone-footage-detection) | Multipart-uploads dashcam or drone video, runs YOLO detection on keyframes, and writes detections correlated with the GPS track as GeoJSON to B2. | [sensor-lake-scenario-mining](../architectures/sensor-lake-scenario-mining/architecture.md) |

| [ByteTrack Dataset Builder](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/bytetrack-dataset-builder) | Builds versioned multi-object tracking (MOT) datasets from raw video on B2; a tracking pre-label pattern. | [multisensor-labeling](../architectures/multisensor-labeling/architecture.md) |
| [YOLO11 Batch Detection Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/yolo11-batch-detection-pipeline) | Runs batch 2D detection and segmentation over B2 image and video libraries and writes COCO JSON pre-labels and crops back to B2. | [multisensor-labeling](../architectures/multisensor-labeling/architecture.md) |

## Operational building blocks

<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:start -->
| Sample | Reusable pattern |
|---|---|
| [B2 Event Broker](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-event-broker) | Verifies signed B2 Event Notifications, acknowledges promptly, and fans them out to subscribers that start extraction and validation. |
| [b2listen](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2listen) | Forwards B2 Event Notifications to a local service during development. It is a development tool only and is not listed in the Backblaze Labs feed. |
| [DuckDB Query In Place](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/duckdb-query-in-place) | Queries Parquet, CSV, and JSON in B2 through DuckDB httpfs with a custom endpoint and range reads. |
| [Iceberg Feature Store](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/iceberg-feature-store) | Creates PyIceberg tables on B2 with a local SQL catalog and demonstrates schema evolution, snapshot rollback, and DuckDB time travel. |
| [Lance Multimodal Search](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lance-multimodal-search) | Stores a LanceDB vector table and its ANN index directly on B2 next to the media it indexes. |
| [WebDataset Streaming PyTorch Training](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/webdataset-streaming-pytorch-training) | Streams tar shards from B2 into PyTorch with worker- and node-aware shard splits and no local staging. |
| [lakeFS on B2 Quickstart](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lakefs-on-b2-quickstart) | Runs lakeFS branch, commit, and merge over a B2 blockstore. The repository is public but not listed in the Backblaze Labs feed. |
| [fastdup Dataset Cleaning](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/fastdup-dataset-cleaning) | Finds duplicate, outlier, and broken frames on B2 and quarantines them without deleting the originals. |
<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:end -->

## Domain-specific samples

These samples use autonomous-driving formats and tools (nuScenes, KITTI-style LiDAR, KISS-ICP LiDAR odometry, CARLA) through an S3 SDK. The tools themselves have no S3 connector.

<!-- catalog:samples-domain:start -->
- [nuScenes Sensor Data Lake](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/nuscenes-sensor-data-lake): Stores nuScenes-format camera, LiDAR, and radar blobs on B2 and indexes them with the devkit. Only the small annotation tables are materialized locally, and per-keyframe training manifests are served through presigned URLs. Related: [sensor-lake-scenario-mining](../architectures/sensor-lake-scenario-mining/architecture.md), [perception-training-data-checkpoints](../architectures/perception-training-data-checkpoints/architecture.md).
- [MMDetection3D LiDAR Dataset](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/mmdetection3d-lidar-dataset): Turns KITTI-style LiDAR into 3D detection datasets, with pre-labels, manifests, and checkpoints written to B2 through boto3. The worker uses boto3 for B2 object access. Related: [multisensor-labeling](../architectures/multisensor-labeling/architecture.md), [perception-training-data-checkpoints](../architectures/perception-training-data-checkpoints/architecture.md).
- [KISS-ICP LiDAR Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/kiss-icp-lidar-archive): Ingests LiDAR scan frames, runs KISS-ICP odometry and incremental mapping, and archives raw scans, per-batch poses, .ply map snapshots, and the session trajectory to B2 through the S3-compatible API. The archive worker handles B2 access for LiDAR odometry and map artifacts alongside sensor-lake tables. Related: [sensor-lake-scenario-mining](../architectures/sensor-lake-scenario-mining/architecture.md).
- [CARLA Sensor Data Lake](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/carla-sensor-data-lake): Stores CARLA scenario configs on B2 and streams each episode's RGB, segmentation, depth, LiDAR, and vehicle-state frames there through boto3, then serves them to a PyTorch DataLoader with presigned URLs. The simulation worker handles B2 access through boto3. Related: [simulation-resim-evaluation](../architectures/simulation-resim-evaluation/architecture.md).
<!-- catalog:samples-domain:end -->

## Selection guidance

- Pick the sample that shows the implementation pattern you are missing, rather than linking every adjacent sample.
- Keep key scoping, retention, anonymization, and Object Lock decisions in this repository's architecture documents. The samples simplify them.
- Treat sample manifests as examples. Validate or transform them before using them as dataset or evidence records.
- Configure authentication, tenant isolation, scoped credentials, retention, and recovery for the deployment.
- KISS-ICP LiDAR Archive is listed because the Backblaze Labs feed tags it for autonomous vehicles; the robotics repository lists it too. Open3D Point Cloud Pipeline is not tagged for autonomous vehicles and stays in the robotics category.
